gaps: Local forceRespawn emits the recovered event shape; automatic engine respawn triggers remain unverified.
The recovered optional filter is implemented; automatic engine respawn triggers remain unverified.

Script-produced GameEntity.hurt calls preserve enableDamage, healing, attacker, damageType, hp transitions, recovered GameDamageEvent fields, native replica.damage state, and game-net hurt effects; non-script engine damage ingress remains unverified.
The recovered optional filter, script-produced hurt events, and native client damage transport are implemented; non-script engine damage ingress remains unverified.
Script-produced hurt emits one GameDieEvent when hp crosses from positive to zero and queues the native game-net die effect; non-script engine death transitions remain unverified.
Recovered event fields are emitted by the local bridge; native moderation, cancellation, and transport timing remain unverified.
The game-net bridge reconstructs the declared GameClickEvent fields, applies the recovered PlayerFlags mask, and dispatches the same event to world and the clicked entity in historical order.
Non-player clicks require an authoritative backend entity binding; the latest capture still has two entities without sufficient model evidence for projection.
The event surface and local physics dispatch exist; native fluid metadata and exact transition timing remain unverified.
The event surface and local physics dispatch exist; native fluid metadata and exact transition timing remain unverified.
The event surface is dispatchable, but automatic native death-state production remains unverified.
The event surface is dispatchable; full native GameEntityContactEvent production remains covered separately by the contact model.
The event surface is dispatchable; the native purchase producer and full payload remain unverified.
Local elapsedTimeMS uses the configured fixed interval instead of the historical wall-clock measurement.
Historical skip calculation and delayed-tick behavior are not yet reproduced.
Event fields now match GameEntityEvent, but RuntimePlayer is still only a subset of GamePlayerEntity.
Event fields now match GameEntityEvent, but RuntimePlayer is still only a subset of GamePlayerEntity.
The recovered impulse-derived GameVoxelContactEvent force is implemented; RuntimePlayer is still only a subset of GamePlayerEntity.
The recovered impulse-derived GameVoxelContactEvent force is implemented; RuntimePlayer is still only a subset of GamePlayerEntity.
Local collider abstraction is not a historical GameEntityContactEvent.
Local collider abstraction is not a historical GameEntityContactEvent.
The recovered optional filter and GameTickEvent resolution are implemented; elapsedTimeMS, skip, and delayed-tick timing retain the same gaps as world.onTick.
The recovered optional filter and GameEntityEvent fields are implemented; RuntimePlayer remains a subset of GamePlayerEntity.
Local implementation records/logs messages but does not yet prove historical broadcast delivery and limits.

Creation remains synchronous and emits the recovered entity-create lifecycle event. Captured mesh bindings can create an authoritative browser/backend replica with documented transform and model/body fields; unknown meshes deliberately remain script-local rather than receiving a fabricated placeholder.
Generic native gravity, collision response, and in-place Vector3 mutation replication are still unverified.
The recovered GameEntityEvent is emitted for local script-created entities; independent native engine creation is not bridged.
The recovered optional filter resolves local script-created entity events; independent native engine creation is not bridged.
The recovered GameEntityEvent is emitted for local script destruction; independent native engine destruction is not bridged.
The recovered optional filter resolves local script destruction events; independent native engine destruction is not bridged.
Local selector grammar supports only id, tag and kind subsets.
Local selector grammar supports only id, tag and kind subsets.

Voxel DDA, fluid filtering, selector filtering, player/entity AABBs, recovered result fields, the historical Infinity maxDistance default, and zero-direction preservation are implemented and exercised by conformance tests and the BedWars corpus.

The recovered engine raycastBoxes implementation and body-orientation semantics are not available locally; entity intersections therefore remain an explicit AABB approximation. GameWorld.useOBB is a separate world-physics property, not a GameRaycastOptions field.
Filter registration/list lifecycle is implemented; the local physics solver does not yet consume selector pairs.
Zone creation, polling, enter/leave events, and removal exist; selector grammar and environmental effects remain partial.
The recovered property is script-visible, but writes do not yet reconfigure the fixed-step physics engine.
The recovered property is script-visible, but writes do not yet reconfigure the fixed-step physics engine.
The recovered GameRGBColor property is script-visible; client rendering propagation remains unimplemented.
The declared GameClickEvent fields and world-to-target dispatch order are implemented when an authoritative entity binding exists.
The recovered optional filter is implemented; resolution still depends on an authoritative entity binding.
Local destruction removes mapped non-player entities and emits the recovered destroy lifecycle event; native engine-driven destruction remains unverified.
The lifecycle event is emitted exactly once for local destruction; non-script engine destruction remains unverified.
The recovered optional filter resolves local destruction events; non-script engine destruction remains unverified.
Player destruction uses the same lifecycle contract while preserving player identity; native disconnect and engine destruction semantics remain unverified.
The player lifecycle event is emitted for local destruction; native disconnect and engine destruction semantics remain unverified.
The recovered optional filter resolves local player destruction events; native disconnect and engine destruction semantics remain unverified.
Clicked players receive the same GameClickEvent after world dispatch when their backend player id is authoritative.
The recovered optional filter is implemented; resolution still depends on an authoritative backend player id.

Script-produced events and filters are implemented; authoritative backend DamageBinding ingress remains unverified.
Position, velocity, contacts, triggers, backend state, and respawn events are updated; native death-state side effects remain unverified.

Local JSON persistence implements the recovered data-space operations; native cloud scope, quotas, consistency, and version semantics remain unverified.
